parts.name: API Gateway
parts.summary: Primary backend entry point for auth, jobs, applications, candidates, interviews, workspaces, analytics, health, metrics, storage, and queue publishing.

parts.name: CV Parser
parts.summary: Queue-driven worker that consumes CV upload events, downloads files from S3-compatible storage, parses documents with OCR fallback, extracts structured data with Gemini/rule-based logic, and publishes parsed or failed outcomes; persistence is still a no-op placeholder.

parts.name: Notification
parts.summary: Runtime notification shell with JWT auth, health checks, Prisma schema, and a sample notification lookup route; email, WebSocket, and RabbitMQ delivery flows are still placeholders.

integration.storage: S3-compatible object storage (MinIO locally, Cloudflare R2 in production)
integration.database: PostgreSQL via Prisma in API Gateway and notification scaffold
integration.notes: API Gateway publishes cv.uploaded; CV Parser consumes it and publishes cv.parsed/cv.failed; Notification exists as a runtime scaffold with auth, health, and Prisma wiring, but its message consumers and delivery channels are not fully implemented yet.
